name: knowledge
description: The same questions asked three ways: with no reference documents (a control that cannot know the answers), with searched passages (rag) and with the documents fixed at the start of the context (cag). Compare accuracy, tokens read and the prefix cache hit rate to choose the size at which a fixed block stops paying. The company and its facts are invented.

docs.handbook/ports.md:
# Service ports

The metrics gateway listens on port 9314. The build cache listens on port 5827. The old billing mirror was on port 7002 and has been switched off; do not use it.

All ports bind to the internal network only.
docs.handbook/oncall.md:
# On-call rota

The on-call engineer for the week of 3 November is Marta Ruzzi. The week after, 10 November, it is Teodor Lund. A swap needs the written approval of the duty manager, currently Ines Okafor.

Pages go to the pager first and to chat after five minutes.
docs.handbook/release.md:
# Release rules

Releases are frozen from 18 December to 6 January. Hotfixes during a freeze need the code word LANTERN in the ticket. The release train leaves every Thursday at 14:30 local time.

A release candidate must have two approvals.
docs.handbook/naming.md:
# Naming

Branches use the prefix feat/ for features, fix/ for bug fixes and chore/ for maintenance. Ticket keys have the form ORB-1234. Internal libraries are named with the prefix orb- and a short noun.

Never use spaces in repository names.
docs.handbook/limits.md:
# Rate limits

The public API allows 240 requests per minute per key. Bulk exports are limited to 15 per day. Uploads larger than 80 MB must use the resumable endpoint.

Limits are raised only by the platform team.
docs.handbook/backup.md:
# Backups

Databases are backed up nightly at 02:15 and kept for 35 days. Object storage is replicated to the Oslo region within one hour. A restore drill happens on the first Monday of each quarter.

Backup keys are held by two people, never one.
docs.handbook/contacts.md:
# Contacts

Security reports go to the address secure@orbit.example. Billing questions go to the finance desk, extension 4410. The facilities desk is open from 08:00 to 17:30.

Do not send credentials by email.
docs.handbook/glossary.md:
# Glossary

A harbor is a group of services deployed together. A tide is a scheduled batch job. A reef is a read-only replica of a database.

Terms are used exactly as written here in tickets and reviews.

tasks.prompt: Which port does the metrics gateway listen on? Answer with the number only.
